evidence_basis: Granite 4 passed runtime, schema and v1.1 substantive deterministic validation on the same Constellation packet.

Human adjudication found a universalized E-029 claim not justified by stated acquisition criteria, duplicate use of two priority slots on recurring-revenue share metrics, an E-063 unresolved question already answered on the same packet, and omission of E-066/E-067 direct serial-acquirer moat inputs.
The weak-link and conflict-handling sections were materially cleaner than prior Gemma and Phi-4 runs, but priority selection and exact grounding remain critical.
